rows: Procedure: Washing the Anion with Brine and Soda — Brine Cleaning System — Removal of Organic Materials Stuck to the Resin — WTD, the Manufacturer
Issued to: Talkha Power Station 750 MW

sections_target.text: Introduction
Washing the anion with brine and soda is used to remove the organic materials stuck to the resin; the brine and soda solution consists of 10% sodium chloride and 2% caustic soda.
This document was prepared by Chemist Mohamed Ahmed El-Tara, and reviewed by Chemist Zakia Mahmoud Sultan, Manager of the Chemistry Department at Talkha Steam Power Station.

The document was reviewed by Chemist Saad Sadeek Hasanen in the Inspection and Quality Control Sector of the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company, with the approval of Engineer Samir Abdel Galil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality Control of the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the Company's Coordinator for the Maintenance Procedures Information System, and certified by Engineer Mohamed Nageeb Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector of the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Since caustic materials are used in large quantities, it is essential to take full safety precautions for those handling them, such as:

rows: Open a work order, and workers must carry an occupational safety and health category card.
Wearing the personnel uniform and the appropriate personal protective equipment.
Placing Safety tags on valves and instruments when needed.
Ensuring that the place is equipped with suitable fire-extinguishing means, in quantity and type.

sections_target.text: Tools and Equipment Used

rows: Injection pumps, daily treatment chemicals tank.
Occupational safety and health equipment such as gloves and safety shoes, etc.

sections_target.text: Maintenance Procedures
Preparation of the Brine Solution

rows: Put 2 tons of salt in the salt tank (Brine Tank), filling the tank with hot water to 20 m3, at a temperature of 60-70 °C, and a brine concentration of 10%.
Mixing by running a closed cycle (Recycle) by means of the (Brine Feed Pumps).

sections_target.text: Washing Steps
1. Drain the anion through the manual valve below the anion until it is fully drained.
2. Fill the anion with hot water as follows:

items: Open the anion regeneration inlet valve.
Run the regeneration water pump at a rate of 50 m3/h.
The temperature of the water entering the anion is 50 °C.

sections_target.text: 3. Wait for 30 minutes, then blow down.
4. Fill the anion only with brine (10%) and soda (4.8%) and soak as follows:

items: Open the manual valve for brine entry to the anion.
Close the Recycle valve on the salt tank so that the brine passes to the anion at a rate of 9 m3/h.
Open the soda inlet valve to the anion.
Open the backwash Drain valve (used as a Vent in this step).
Open the soda inlet valve to mix with the dilution water.
Close the manual valve on the anion (the brine inlet valve to the anion), opening the Recycle valve on the salt tank, and stop the soda injection.

sections_target.text: 5. Air enters from below the anion for 5 minutes.
6. Leave the anion for one and a half hours (soaking the resin). Note: all valves are closed except the manual Vent valve of the anion.
7. Dispose of the wash salt inside the anion as follows:

items: Air enters from below the anion.
Open the regeneration products outlet valve. Note: the water comes out dark brown.
Drain through the manual valve on the anion until fully drained.

sections_target.text: 8. Repeat the steps from step 2 to step 7.
Note: in step 8, 21% was drawn from the salt tank and 3.5 cm was drawn from the daily soda tank.
9. Repeat the steps from step 2 to step 8 to use the third and last part of the brine solution.
Note: the last 30% was drawn from the salt tank and 3.5 cm was drawn from the soda tank.
10. Only hot water enters the anion, and water exits from the regeneration products outlet valve for two hours.
11. Fill the anion with hot water and drain through the manual valve below the anion.
Note: repeat step 11 until it is confirmed that the salt has been removed.
12. Back Wash the anion in the normal way.
13. Press the resin inside the anion by entering through the carbon filter, the pump, the cation, the deaerator and the pump, to enter the anion from the top to press the resin for only 5 minutes.

Preparation of the Brine Solution
 | Put 2 tons of salt in the salt tank (Brine Tank), filling the tank with hot water to 20 m3, at a temperature of 60-70 °C, and a brine concentration of 10%.

Washing Steps
1. Drain the anion through the manual valve below the anion until it is fully drained.
2. Fill the anion with hot water as follows:
Open the anion regeneration inlet valve.
Open the backwash Drain valve.
Open the water dilution valve.
Run the regeneration water pump at a rate of 50 m3/h.
The temperature of the water entering the anion is 50 °C.
3. Wait for 30 minutes, then blow down.
4. Fill the anion only with brine (10%) and soda (4.8%) and soak as follows:
Open the manual valve for brine entry to the anion.
Close the Recycle valve on the salt tank so that the brine passes to the anion at a rate of 9 m3/h.
Open the soda inlet valve to the anion.
Open the backwash Drain valve (used as a Vent in this step).
Open the soda inlet valve to mix with the dilution water.
Open the water dilution valve.
Close the manual valve on the anion (the brine inlet valve to the anion), opening the Recycle valve on the salt tank, and stop the soda injection.
5. Air enters from below the anion for 5 minutes.
6. Leave the anion for one and a half hours (soaking the resin). Note: all valves are closed except the manual Vent valve of the anion.
7. Dispose of the wash salt inside the anion as follows:
Hot water enters the anion.
Air enters from below the anion.
Open the regeneration products outlet valve. Note: the water comes out dark brown.
Drain through the manual valve on the anion until fully drained.
8. Repeat the steps from step 2 to step 7.
Note: in step 8, 21% was drawn from the salt tank and 3.5 cm was drawn from the daily soda tank.
9. Repeat the steps from step 2 to step 8 to use the third and last part of the brine solution.
Note: the last 30% was drawn from the salt tank and 3.5 cm was drawn from the soda tank.
10. Only hot water enters the anion, and water exits from the regeneration products outlet valve for two hours.
11. Fill the anion with hot water and drain through the manual valve below the anion.
Note: repeat step 11 until it is confirmed that the salt has been removed.
12. Back Wash the anion in the normal way.
13. Press the resin inside the anion by entering through the carbon filter, the pump, the cation, the deaerator and the pump, to enter the anion from the top to press the resin for only 5 minutes.
